**Cross-valdation**

-   A model trained on a set of folds will be overfit, but not overfit on the remaining sample

-   Cross-validated GOF for the $ith$ folds, then average all CV GOFS

    -   Model is not overfit for fold 1 and testing sample

    -   Folds are random samples (we hope that the train and test are too

    -   hold-out fold and test are unbiased estimates of GOF

    -   but they are samples so they all have noise

-   Likely uses nelder mead or newton raphson algorithm to select
